collection.title: Peugeot 2008 2013 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 2008 2013 - 2019 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this 2008, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
